arguments.need: I have a side project idea written up as a rough product description and feature list, but no time to sit and code it. I want something that takes my description and keeps building the app on its own on a timer, committing working changes and undoing anything that breaks the build or tests. It has to work with a local model through Ollama so I don't need a paid API key, and I'd like it to keep a running log of what it tried and learned between sessions.
